tbesh_html:
1) to fear, tremble, revere, dread, be in awe or dread
1a) (Qal)
1a1) to be in dread
1a2) to be in awe
1b) (Piel) to be in great dread
1c) (Hiphil) to cause to dread

strongs_1890.strongs_def: to be startled (by a sudden alarm); hence, to fear in general
strongs_1890.kjv_def: be afraid, stand in awe, (be in) fear, make to shake.
